summary: Ares Commercial Real Estate Corporation reported that a wholly-owned subsidiary completed the sale of a multi-building North Carolina office property to an unaffiliated buyer for $64 million cash on September 18, 2026. The company had taken legal title via deed in lieu of foreclosure on September 19, 2024, and classified the asset as held for sale beginning in Q1 2026. No board recommendation or advisor was named. Pro forma balance sheet and income statements were filed to reflect the disposition as of June 30, 2026 and January 1, 2025. Watch for the realized gain or loss versus carrying value and redeployment of proceeds.
